loop_check_corpo: Exit 0 = done. Use the project's real gate (suggested chips). Good check: fast (<2min), deterministic, runs the same twice. No check possible → the loop only stops with YOUR confirmation; supervise more closely. The check runs as a single command (argv), no shell: "&&", "|" and redirection do not work — to chain, create a script in the repo and use it as the check.
loop_check_label: Check (command that decides when it's done)
loop_check_placeholder: empty = stops only with your confirmation
loop_check_titulo: Check — a command decides when it is done.
loop_como_escrever: ? How to write a good loop
loop_dica_corpo: ask for evidence, not promises — include "run the check and show the output" in the goal.
loop_iteracoes_corpo: Start with 5–10. Blew past it without passing? Do not raise the number — improve the goal or the check. A loop that "needs the whole night" = scope too big.
loop_objetivo_corpo: Final result, not steps; small and verifiable. ✗ "refactor the project" / ✓ "migrate utils/date.ts to date-fns and keep npm run check green". Big task → break it into a plan file and have the loop do "the next pending item".
loop_objetivo_placeholder: e.g. migrate utils/date.ts to date-fns while keeping npm run check green
loop_reescreve_objetivo: Rewrites the goal following loop best practices
loop_sinais_corpo: Same error 2× → the app stops on its own (stagnation); fix A breaking B alternately → split the scope; agent touching tests → the re-prompt already forbids it, but review the diff.
loop_terminou_confirma: The loop finished and marked itself done. Confirm?
